note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Palestinian Territory, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database's metadata labels the figures ILS, but its market exchange rate in local currency per US dollar (xlcusx999i) is 1 for 2024, and per euro 1.08, the dollar's, so they are read as USD, as the database's own rates show them to be. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j, xlcusxi999 for xlcusx999i), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]).
